changes.reason: Re-appointment for a period of 1 year pursuant to approval of the Reserve Bank of India and recommendation of the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
changes.background: He was previously the Executive Director & Chief Financial Officer of HDFC Limited prior to its amalgamation with the Bank. He has vast experience in the housing finance and real estate sector along with expertise in finance, accountancy, audit, economics, corporate governance, and risk management.
changes.education: Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from University of Delhi; Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
previous_roles: Executive Director & Chief Financial Officer of HDFC Limited

headline: HDFC Bank re-appoints V. Srinivasa Rangan as Executive Director for one year
